seo.defaultDescription: Capture sources, notes, and decisions as you browse. Trail turns tab chaos into organized research trails you can share without storing page content.
seo.privacyDescription: Learn what data is collected, how it is stored, and the choices you have to control sharing, retention, exports, and deletion requests.
seo.termsDescription: Review responsibilities, acceptable use, billing, and how the product is provided, including updates, suspension, and termination.
seo.supportDescription: Get help with Trail. Check service status and contact our support team.

landing.srHeading: Trail — a Chrome extension that turns your browsing into a living tree.

01.title:
Every browser session
starts from one root.
01.body: You open a tab. One thought. One question. The path ahead is unwritten.

02.title:
But the web is
a thousand forks.
02.body: Tabs split. You backtrack. You revisit. By page seven, the trail is gone.

03.title:
Trail watches
the roots grow.
03.body: A Chrome extension that turns your browsing into a living tree — every click, every detour, every fork preserved.

04.title:
See where
you've been.
04.body: Pages become nodes. Navigation becomes branches. Your research finally has a shape.

05.title:
Pick up
any thread.
05.body: Jump back to where the idea forked. Pin the pages that mattered. Never lose a path again.

static.title:

static.body: Trail turns your browsing into a living tree — every click, every detour, every fork preserved.

features.subheading: Six things Trail does that your history page never could.

graph.title: A graph, not a list
graph.body: Forks when you open from one tab twice. Merges when you revisit. The shape of your research, preserved.

panel.title: Lives in the sidepanel
panel.body: Always next to whatever you are reading. ⌘K to search across every node you have ever visited.

lock.title: Local-first
lock.body: Nothing leaves your device by default. Cloud sync is opt-in, end-to-end. Your trail is yours.

pin.title: Pin & prune
pin.body: Mark what mattered. Delete dead-ends. Reparent and rearrange — undo with ⌘Z, just like text.

forest.title: Many trees
forest.body: One for that side project. One for that thesis. Switch contexts without losing the path.

keys.title: Keyboard-native
keys.body: ⌘K to search, ⌘Z to undo, ⇧L to cycle layouts, P to pin. Built for hands that never leave the home row.

demo.heading: A tree, in your hands.
demo.subheading: Trail lives in your sidepanel — always there, always one click away. Pick a node on the right; the page on the left follows.
demo.tip: Click any node on the right — the page follows
